scope: Generic teaching patterns, not preloaded declarations or Euclid answers. Adapt fresh names and preserve the actual task target.

patterns.instruction: Use an explicit definition and unfold it before polynomial reasoning.
patterns.code:
def fast_shift (x : ℝ) : ℝ := x + 1
theorem fast_expand (x : ℝ) : fast_shift x - 1 = x := by
  unfold fast_shift
  ring

patterns.instruction: Use rcases to introduce a witness and its property from a known existential.
patterns.code:
theorem fast_extract (t : ℝ) (h : ∃ x : ℝ, x = t) : ∃ y : ℝ, y = t := by
  rcases h with ⟨u, hu⟩
  exact ⟨u, hu⟩

patterns.instruction: Introduce the assumed existential, extract its witness and derive a contradiction from equality and inequality.
patterns.code:
theorem fast_not_exist (t : ℝ) : ¬ ∃ x : ℝ, x = t ∧ x ≠ t := by
  intro h
  rcases h with ⟨u, heq, hne⟩
  exact hne heq

patterns.instruction: Use Prod.ext after establishing both coordinate equalities.
patterns.code:
theorem fast_tuple_equal (p q : GeoPoint) (hx : p.1 = q.1) (hy : p.2 = q.2) : p = q := by
  exact Prod.ext hx hy

patterns.instruction: A mathematical predicate is a definition returning Prop. Apply it using its explicit argument list.

Build the same quantified condition from named inner predicates. Each helper keeps all free parameters explicit. This defines an exists/forall/exists condition; it does not prove existence. Keep quantifier order and witness dependencies unchanged.
Set comprehensions use {x : T | condition}; membership facts use x ∈ S with S : Set T. A universal inclusion is not equality of sets.
patterns.code:
def fast_level (t : ℝ) : Set ℝ := {z : ℝ | z = t}
def fast_contains (S : Set ℝ) (z : ℝ) : Prop := z ∈ S
def fast_included (A B : Set ℝ) : Prop := ∀ z : ℝ, z ∈ A → z ∈ B
theorem fast_level_member (t : ℝ) : t ∈ fast_level t := by
  change t = t
  rfl

patterns.instruction: A restricted interface may take a proof argument hx : x ≠ 0; supply it when calling the function. Inspect actual function types. Noncomputable marks computation status, not an unfinished proof. Never remove domain conditions to silence type errors.
patterns.code:
noncomputable def fast_recip (x : ℝ) (_hx : x ≠ 0) : ℝ := 1 / x
theorem fast_recip_cancel (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) : fast_recip x hx * x = 1 := by
  unfold fast_recip
  field_simp

patterns.instruction: A predicate can name a disjunction; ∧ and ∨ retain distinct scopes. Explicit logical parentheses are supported. Preserve the same conjunction and disjunction as the mathematical source.
patterns.code:
def fast_some_nonzero (a b : ℝ) : Prop := a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0
def fast_admissible_pair (a b : ℝ) : Prop := a + b = 1 ∧ fast_some_nonzero a b
